description: This Java source file defines the final class ProductUtilServices which contains various static utility service methods related to product management in the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include operations like discarding virtual products with variants, removing category memberships of discontinued products, creating standalone products from single-variant virtuals, updating product images, attaching features to categories, and merging virtual products with their variants.

classes.name: ProductUtilServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods for product management in OFBiz.

methods.name: discVirtualsWithDiscVariants
methods.description: Expires all ProductAssoc entries for variant products with sales discontinuation and discontinues virtual products with all variant associations expired.

methods.name: removeCategoryMembersOfDiscProducts
methods.description: Removes category memberships for products that have been discontinued.

methods.name: removeDuplicateOpenEndedCategoryMembers
methods.description: Removes duplicate category membership entries for products within the same category.

methods.name: makeStandAloneFromSingleVariantVirtuals
methods.description: Converts virtual products with only one variant into independent products, merging data and categories.

methods.name: mergeVirtualWithSingleVariant
methods.description: Replaces a virtual product with its single variant, copying over related information and optionally removing the virtual.

methods.name: duplicateRelated
methods.description: Helper method to clone related entity entries from a virtual product to its associated variant.

methods.name: setAllProductImageNames
methods.description: Sets product image URLs based on a naming pattern, updating virtual and variant products accordingly.

methods.name: clearAllVirtualProductImageNames
methods.description: Clears image URL fields for all virtual products.

methods.name: attachProductFeaturesToCategory
methods.description: Associates product features with categories, creating feature groups and applying features to subcategories as needed.

methods.name: attachProductFeaturesToCategory (recursive method)
methods.description: Recursively attaches features from subcategories to a given category, creating feature groups and applications.
